title: Chapter 1058
text:
Sagman and the others were still in a state of shock from Han Xiao's energy wave. They did not expect Black Star to really attack. They were shocked and hurriedly took defensive measures.

Rumble — —

The next moment, the figures of more than ten Beyond Grade As were instantly drowned in the sea of Mech Legion.

As soon as the battle began, the shock in everyone's hearts became even more intense. They felt an unparalleled pressure from the Mech Legion.

If it was an army of ordinary Beyond Grade A Mechanics, they would have been able to kill them easily. However, Han Xiao's Mech Legion made them feel as if they were trapped in a quagmire. Only Kasuyi and Sierron had the ability to move freely.

This was not only because the size of the Mech Legion brought by Han Xiao's main body was dozens of times larger than the two Mechanics present. It was also because the strength of the mechanical army was beyond their imagination. The bonuses given by Mechanical Force to the mechanical soldiers were a whole level higher!

Han Xiao already had the (Perfect Mechanical Sense) talent. Now that he used Nero's Character Summon Card and stacked two Perfect Mechanical Sense talents, his Machinery Affinity reached a whole new level.

Facing this overwhelming pressure, the Beyond Grade As of Radiance and Ethereal did not have time to think about anything else. They subconsciously worked together to block the attacks of the Mech Legion.

Boom!

The battle erupted, instantly entering a white-hot and intense state, turning into a scene of a great chaotic battle.

In the endless black tide of the Mech Legion, there were more than ten light balls moving in this ocean. Countless beams of light gathered toward these light balls. These light balls were the battlefield where the Mech Legion surrounded the Beyond Grade As.

"How did his strength soar to such a level?" Sagman's tone was filled with shock.

"The last time Black Star went all out was during the battle of Planet Lighthouse. Now that more than twenty years have passed, this is the second time he's gone all out, and he's actually become so much stronger!" Taylor was shocked, panicked, and envious.

More than twenty years ago, these people from Ethereal who had participated in the battle of Planet Lighthouse still remembered Han Xiao's performance clearly. Now that more than twenty years had passed, they knew that Black Star had become stronger, but they did not expect him to be this strong!

"This level of pressure, it feels like the Mecha Empire …" Kasuyi's expression was grave.

He was also within Han Xiao's attack range, so he was mainly dodging. He was thinking about what to do next and did not immediately counterattack.

He could understand why Black Star attacked. As the party being attacked, Black Star could not let them easily retreat and had to take the attitude to counterattack. However, the strength Black Star's strength this time exceeded Kasuyi's expectations.

At this moment, Sierron spoke in a deep voice, unable to hide the shock in his tone.

"This is … Ultimate Channel Flow — Cellular Overdrive!"

Hearing this, everyone's shock.

Isn't this an explosive skill of the Pugilist class? Why does Black Star know how to use it? Isn't he a Mechanic?

"I didn't see wrongly. The aura Black Star is giving off is the feeling of this move. Squeezing out one's own potential in exchange for a higher level of strength!" Sierron said firmly. "Let's not talk about why Black Star can use this move first. The principle won't change!"

This explanation was quickly accepted, and everyone's expression became complicated. They looked past the Mech Legion and looked at Han Xiao with shock and surprise.

Does this mean that … Black Star is willing to burn his own potential in order to keep us here?

He could have made us retreat on our own accord. Is there a need to go this far?

If that was the case, it was not surprising that Black Star had such strength. After all, it was only temporary.

However, this level of explosive power was still very scary!

Seeing Han Xiao's firm attitude, many people started to think about retreating.

Kasuyi sighed inwardly.

Originally, he was a little unhappy when he saw Han Xiao suddenly stealing the show and planned to stop him. However, seeing Black Star's firm attitude, Kasuyi put away the idea of going all out.

Since Black Star had put in a lot of effort, he planned to give face and give in to Black Star. After all, he had to act to the end, and he believed that Black Star knew what he was doing.

On the side, Hella saw Han Xiao's power and felt refreshed. Originally, she was shocked and excited, but when she heard this, she was dumbfounded.

The next second, Hella's eyes suddenly turned red, filled with rage and killing intent!

She did not expect Black Star to burn his potential at all costs. Wasn't the reason why Black Star did this to save her?

A heartache that pierced his soul suddenly gushed out, flooding his heart like a flood.

Hella turned her head stiffly, and the way she looked at Han Xiao changed. Only regret and guilt were left, and she could not control her emotions.

"I …"

Hila opened her mouth to say something, but Han Xiao waved his hand and interrupted her, saying casually, "Don't worry.

"You don't have to say anything. I'm fine."

"… I'm sorry."

Hella pursed her lips, clenched her fists, and rushed into the battle formation without saying anything.

The death energy was like a storm, and it followed her toward the Ethereal Beyond Grade As. Her raging anger poured out toward the enemy!

Looking at Hella's uncontrollable killing intent, Han Xiao had a helpless expression.

The aftereffect of Polar Channel Flow — Cellular Overdrive was to permanently increase the cost of upgrading one's character and ability by seven percent, which was equivalent to burning one's potential. However, what these people did not know was that Han Xiao was using the Tyrant's Character Summon Card. Although it could only be used once, the Character Summon Card would not have any side effects.

Sierron's misjudgment caused everyone to misunderstand.

"So be it. It's not a bad thing. In fact, it's beneficial to me." Han Xiao shook his head. Of course, he would not explain.

Some of these Character Summon Cards could only be used once, temporarily giving him super strength. Using them in exchange for permanent abilities was definitely worth it.

He was now filled with an unprecedented sense of strength. The Tyrant's Character Summon Card overclocked his basic attributes and ability, temporarily reaching the level of his next Promotion. The dual Mechanical Sense also increased the strength of his mechanical army. With the two stacked together, his strength had reached a terrifying level.

The ones with the greatest enhancement were the elite forces such as the Apostle Weapons.

…

Swoosh!

Red Devil Tolaen leaned back and barely dodged Psionic Prime's simple spear. His thick magical energy shield was cut in half, and a deep wound appeared on his chest that was full of bone spikes, revealing his copper ribs.

Tolaen hurriedly swung his tail and used the bone spurs on his tail to hit Psionic Prime's mechanical body. Psionic Prime did not panic and directly blocked the attack with his spear.

Bang!

The spear and bone collided, and a shockwave spread out!

Tolaen was a melee Mage who focused on enhancing himself, so he had stacked a large number of enhancement spells. However, Psionic Prime, who was surrounded by golden Mechanical Force, blocked the powerful demon tail and did not back off.

"Help, help! His Apostle Weapons are too strong! "Tolaen exclaimed.

With the Mechanical Force boost from dual Mechanical Sense, just Psionic Prime alone was enough to make him feel pressured.

Furthermore, Psionic Prime was not the only one dealing with him. The melee forces such as Heaven-Suppressing Banner and Purple Sky Spirit, as well as the long-range damage dealers such as Silver Flash and Crimson Flame were all attacking Tolaen.

Han Xiao's plan was to use the Mech Legion to restrain the others while focusing the elites on one target.

Sagman was also heavily surrounded and was fighting the Mech Legion. He could not help but feel annoyed when he heard Han Xiao's words. "You're so useless!"

However, he could not not help his own people, so he had no choice but to provide help. He turned around and attacked the Apostle Weapons surrounding Tolaen, and a powerful light energy shockwave shot out.

Hum!

At this time, countless nanoparticles gushed out from the middle and suddenly turned into a large fortress, separating Tolaen's battlefield.

Streams of light flowed on the surface of this large mechanical fortress, which quickly gathered and formed a pale golden semi-transparent light screen, blocking the light energy shockwave.

Boom boom boom —

Sagman's attacks all landed on this pale golden light screen. In an instant, electric arcs shot out, dazzling the entire area!

Very soon, the light from the explosions dissipated, and this light screen did not move at all. It flickered slightly and blocked this wave of attacks, protecting this mechanical fortress tightly.

"What a strong defense!" Sagman was shocked.

This mechanical fortress was one of Han Xiao's Apostle Weapons, called Sky Wall. This light screen was similar to Psionic Prime's spear and was also a companion weapon of an Apostle Weapon. It was called 'Wall of Defense' and focused on defense.

However, Sky Wall had more than one companion weapon. It also had another offensive weapon, 'Ion Green Flame'.

A large number of cannons extended from this fortress, spitting out beams of green light toward Sagman and the others. This was his unique 'Ion Green Flame', a special type of plasma energy. Not only did it have destructive power, but it also had many special effects.

"Sh * t, I've been isolated." Seeing this, Tolaen panicked. Just as he wanted to get rid of the entanglement and regroup with his teammates, he suddenly felt a piercing sense of danger.

All of a sudden, a small black beam of light shot out from the gaps of the surrounding mechanical army and easily penetrated his magic shield. Tolaen hurriedly dodged, but this beam of light still hit his shoulder.

Boom!

The next moment, a huge wound suddenly appeared on Tolaen's shoulder. He had received True Damage.

He covered his wound and dodged, panicking as he looked in the direction the beam of light came from. He saw a dark humanoid Apostle Weapon aiming a special gun at him.

When Tolaen looked over, this Apostle Weapon suddenly turned invisible and disappeared.

Dark Shadow, a sniper assassin-type Apostle Weapon. Its companion weapon was' Divine Concealment Paint ', which had extremely powerful stealth, stealth, camouflage, and environmental concealment functions. The gun in its hand was also a highly concentrated sniper gun, extremely lethal against single targets.

"Damn it, what kind of weapon is this? My recovery ability is suppressed …"

Before Tolaen could catch his breath, the Mysterious Energy Host arrived and blasted a thick beam of light from afar. Tolaen could only barely activate his magic shield to block it.

However, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy also had the mental attribute. Although Tolaen blocked the attack, his soul was also impacted, interrupting his casting.

Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hila did not hold back. Death energy rained down on Tolaen's body like a storm, causing him to be covered in wounds and blood.

"Why are you all attacking me?" Tolaen wanted to cry.

Looking around, he was the one in the worst situation.

I'm just a new Beyond Grade A Super. Aren't you bullying me?

While Tolaen was in a perilous situation, Sagman and the others were also anxious as they discussed countermeasures.

"Black Star has too many Mech Legion, and they're too strong. We can't let them hold us here. We have to attack Black Star himself. Taylor, use the Forbidden Spell Scroll on him."

"He has an Indestructible Body. Can we hurt him?"

"We have to do it even if we can't now. There's no better way. Let's focus fire together with the Forbidden Spell Scroll," Sagman said angrily.

Hearing this, Taylor tore open an offensive Forbidden Spell Scroll without hesitation.

Whoosh!

Streaks of black spell meteors shot out from the scroll, piercing through all the psionic shields along the way and heading straight for Han Xiao's body. This spell had an extremely strong penetrative ability, and its attack power was extremely high. It was originally one of the trump cards that Han Xiao had planned to use to heavily injure Hila.

Sagman and the others did not stay idle. Together with the Forbidden Spell Scroll, they focused fire on Han Xiao. Light energy shockwaves, Pugilist shockwaves, high-risk spells, psionic cannons, and so on were all thrown in the direction of Han Xiao, forming a wave of powerful attacks.

The intense energy shockwaves attracted the attention of the Radiance members who were fighting not far away. They all turned to look at the situation and were secretly shocked. If they were facing this kind of attack, most of the Beyond Grade As present would have to avoid it.

The violent energy surged toward him, but Han Xiao did not panic. He did not even move from his spot. With a wave of his hand, spherical mechanical discs quickly gathered. Every disc had a piece of Spacetime Amber on it, and they immediately formed a double-layered shield wall in front of Han Xiao.

Swoosh!

All the long-range energy attacks were like water meeting a reef. They slid away from the Spacetime Amber sphere and could not hurt Han Xiao at all.

Seeing this, everyone's heart sank. They were extremely jealous.

The existence of the Spacetime Amber was no longer a secret. The arrival of Han Xiao's main body meant that this Universal Treasure had arrived.

Since it could even block the attacks of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, the threat of long-range attacks to Han Xiao's main body had been reduced to the lowest. Even without the Spacetime Amber, his tankiness was more than enough to take the attacks head-on.

It was too difficult to hurt Black Star's main body!

"We can use psychic attacks against his main body!" Hades hurriedly said.

Crystal Soul and Hades were both Psychics. They both gathered their strongest psychic energy and attacked Han Xiao's mind from a distance. Seeing this, Kasuyi thought about it and also pretended to attack Han Xiao with a psychic attack.

Psychics were experts in psychic attacks. They could attack the target's soul out of thin air, which was extremely difficult to defend against.

"My shortcomings have been fixed long ago."

Han Xiao's expression did not change. He directly activated Sisko's Character Summon Card, (Psychic — Wall of Mind)!

He did not move at all. Instead, Crystal Soul and Hades, who were attacking with all their might, were shaken. Their psychic energy instantly weakened, and they suffered heavy mental injuries.

Sisko's Character Summon Card could greatly reduce the actual damage of psychic attacks. At the same time, it could also reflect some of the damage. Crystal Soul and Hades did not hold back and took their own attacks. Kasuyi, on the other hand, was only pretending and was not unlucky.

Crystal Soul was still fine. He was stronger, and he also had a Psychic Universal Treasure like the Star Power Crown. His injuries were very light. However, Hades was not strong enough and suffered a huge loss.

"He can even reflect psychic attacks?"

Hades's face turned pale, and he was shocked.

Did this b * stard not have any weaknesses? How did he know everything?

The man and Crystal Soul did not believe it. However, the more they attacked, the more psychic damage was reflected. Han Xiao maintained his calm appearance. On the other hand, the two Psychics were injured by their own attacks.

With his Mental Resistance, the Great Mechanic Han could also block a lot of mental damage, but taking damage was not as good as reflecting it back. Facing more than ten opponents, he would not let go of any opportunity to weaken the enemy's combat power.

…

After fighting for a while, the experts of Radiance and Ethereal were very passive. They were trapped in the sea of Mech Legion and could not move at all.

With such a huge mechanical army, coupled with Han Xiao's True Damage talent, the effect of this was not just to restrain the Beyond Grade As. If they were not careful, they would die on the spot after a few rounds of focus fire. Therefore, everyone was very nervous.

If they were facing an ordinary Mechanic, the dozen Beyond Grade As would have charged forward long ago. However, facing Black Star, most of them did not even have the desire to charge forward.

He was too tanky, so tanky that they did not have any thoughts!

However, this did not include Sierron. As a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist, he was still able to charge left and right unparalleled in the highly enhanced Mech Legion.

Like the Tyrant, he also had True Damage Immunity talents, so he had the ability to ignore the focus fire of the Mech Legion. However, compared to the entire Mech Legion, the number of mechanical soldiers he killed was just a drop in the ocean.

The muscles on Sierron's arms bulged, and he shot a Pugilist wave at Han Xiao. However, it was still reflected by the Spacetime Amber and could not hit Han Xiao at all. Seeing this, he could not help but grit his teeth and talk to Kasuyi calmly.

"Let's work together. You use your psychic power to restrain the Mech Legion and help me get close to Black Star. You know how explosive my power is. I don't want to kill him. Let's see if you can restrain Black Star."

"I'm out of energy," Kasuyi said.

Hearing this, Sierron almost could not breathe.

When you were fighting me just now, you were full of energy and seemed to have an endless amount of energy. Now, you're saying that you're out of energy? Who the f * ck are you lying to?

Furious, Sierron threw Kasuyi aside, knocked away the mechanical soldiers along the way, and charged toward Han Xiao. His four arms were wrapped in highly condensed Pugilist flames like they were coated with a layer of black paint.

"Humph, I knew you were going to attack."

Han Xiao raised his brows. He was already prepared. He immediately activated his ability, and a portion of the mechanical soldiers flew toward him and quickly assembled.

The next moment, the Mechanical Deity that traversed the universe appeared again!

As soon as it appeared, the Mechanical Deity twisted its hips, swung its arms, and punched toward Sierron. Its fist was covered in a white ball of light that fused with psionic energy and force field.

The four black fists collided with the mechanical iron fists that were tens of millions of times larger.

Boom!

A super large circular shockwave exploded and spread out in the universe!

The arm of the Mechanical Deity that was hit by the shockwave quickly disintegrated, and a large number of mechanical parts exploded. Due to Sierron's size disadvantage, he was sent flying who knew how far away by this punch, even faster than he had flown over.

In terms of strength, the two of them were evenly matched.

"This punch of mine can probably even take out a planet's core. Sierron can take it head-on. As expected of a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist."

Han Xiaoxin thought.

At this moment, 'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco saw the appearance of the Mechanical Deity. His eyes flashed, and he immediately contacted Mechanical Queen Mornisa of Radiance.

"He's using the Mechanical Deity. This is our chance. You, me, and Romo, who's providing remote support, will work together and use Virtual Intrusion on the Mechanical Deity. Even if Han Xiao is a Virtual Mechanic, he'll have to be careful when dealing with our intrusion."

"Okay." Mornisa nodded solemnly.

At this juncture, the Beyond Grade As of Radiance and Ethereal had no choice but to temporarily work together and fight against Black Star who was burning his potential.

The three Mechanics quickly worked together in the Virtual World. Green streams of data gushed out and attacked Han Xiao's Virtual Firewall.

Han Xiao immediately noticed the enemy's actions and smiled.

"Oh, you want to invade me?"

With the advantage of the Virtual Specialization and double Mechanical Sense, Han Xiao's Virtual Technology bonuses were extremely high.

Among the three enemies, only 'Defender' Romo was a Virtual Mechanic. The other two were from other specializations, and Romo did not send his Lord's Avatar here. The defense of the main artificial intelligence was still fine, but the power of the Virtual Intrusion was much weaker.

In the Virtual World, Han Xiao and the three of them immediately started fighting without smoke. The three of them kept trying to invade, but Han Xiao's defense was impenetrable and tightly guarded the back door.

On the other hand, the three of them were Virtual Intruded by Han Xiao through the connection. Radiance had two people, and with the computing power of the main artificial intelligence, they were barely able to block Han Xiao's data probes.

However, 'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco was only one person, and he did not specialize in Virtual Technology. His defense was weak, and he was targeted by Han Xiao. Even his back door was damaged.

His mechanical army betrayed him one after another, becoming Han Xiao's reinforcements and attacking his teammates.

"I can't take it anymore!" Francisco could not take it anymore. Even the movement of his Lord's Avatar became sluggish.

At this moment, a giant mechanical hand reached over and grabbed Francisco's Lord's Avatar, who could not dodge in time, and squeezed.

Kacha!

Francisco's Lord's Avatar instantly turned into a pile of scrap metal, and the power that descended was automatically retracted.

Han Xiao curled his lips and casually threw away the remains of Francisco's Lord's Avatar.

"Heh, Brittle Skin."

These Mechanics who used Lord's Descent could not be caught and could be deactivated at any time. If he wanted to make them leave, all he had to do was destroy their Lord's Avatar.

After all, not every Mechanic's Lord's Avatar was as tanky as his.

Seeing this, Mornisa dejectedly gave up on the idea of invading. She could only focus on strengthening her defense and try her best to prevent Han Xiao from breaking through.

At this moment, the situation of the battle suddenly changed.

Under the siege of so many Apostle Weapons and Hella, Tolaen could not hold on at all.

The damage output of the surrounding Mech Legion took up most of the damage. Tolaen did not have the ability to be immune to True Damage, so his health dropped rapidly under the focus fire of the Mech Legion. His other teammates were all pinned down and could not provide support.

Boom! Boom!

"Ah!"

Tolaen was once again drowned in the cannon fire. He was already at his limit, and this time, he had finally reached his limit.

There was not a single piece of flesh on his body that was unharmed. His Demon Horn was broken, and his mind was in a chaotic state from the torture of Hella and the Mysterious Energy Host. He was heavily injured and lost his ability to fight.

Hella was about to kill him, but Han Xiao had the Mechanical Deity reach out and separate her.

"Don't kill him."

"Why, they caused you to …" Hella gritted her teeth, not having the heart to continue.

"Capturing him is more valuable."

Han Xiao shook his head, grabbed the almost unconscious Tolaen, and sucked him into the Mechanical Deity, transporting him to his main body.

Han Xiao took out the Spacetime Amber and directly sealed the defenseless Tolaen.

Looking at this guy's frozen painful expression, Han Xiao showed a satisfied smile, like an old farmer checking his harvest for the year.

"The first one."

…

"Tolaen has been captured!"

Sagman was shocked and angry. Looking at the Mechanical Deity that had captured his teammate, he could not help but feel panic in his heart.

He did not need to think to know that Tolaen was definitely going to have a taste of the Spacetime Amber. He could not help but feel sad for him.

Due to the special tankiness of Black Star's main body, they could not use the same methods to deal with Black Star as they did to normal Mechanics. There was only one path in front of them, which was to destroy Black Star's Mech Legion.

However, Black Star was fighting on his home turf, and he had even burned his potential. Coupled with the unique combat style of a Mechanic, the strength he could unleash was extremely terrifying. It could be divided into three main areas: the Mechanical Deity itself, the elite troops such as the Apostle Weapons, and the huge Mech Legion.

The Mechanical Deity and Sierron were evenly matched, pinning down a single pinnacle Beyond Grade A, while the mechanical army was pinning down many Beyond Grade As. The Apostle Weapons and the other elites were able to split up and destroy the Mechanical Deity and Sierron.

If they continued to fight with Black Star, he did not know how many people they would lose here.

In the past, Black Star only had strong recovery abilities. Now that his combat strength had increased, Sagman's impression of him was that of a crushing existence that made people despair!

"Your Excellency Kasuyi, what should we do now?"

Sagman could not help but look at his captain.

At this moment, the one he trusted the most was still his boss. However, he did not know that Kasuyi had already given them enough leeway to form an ocean.

"Black Star burned his potential in exchange for this kind of strength. He won't be able to last long. The operation has failed, so there's no point in continuing to fight. Let's retreat," Kasuyi said slowly.

"What about Tolaen? Are we going to ignore him?"

"You might not even be able to leave, yet you still have the time to care about others." Kasuyi shook his head.

Although he was the leader, he did not mind Black Star capturing a few people to vent his anger. The way he saw it, Black Star had burned his potential, so it was only right for the Universal Civilization to give him some compensation. After all, he was not the one paying for it.

This group of Beyond Grade As had already offended Black Star by coming to kill Hella. If he did not let him vent this anger, it would not be in line with his and the Mecha Empire's thoughts.

—
